app.name: ChartsUno
app.description: A beautiful chart design tool that turns boring default charts into stunning, presentation-ready data visualizations
app.audience: Startup founders, product managers, designers, and anyone who presents data — people who want their charts to look as good as their ideas
app.problem: Default chart tools produce ugly, generic charts that undermine credibility in pitches, reports, and dashboards
app.differentiator: Instant beautiful charts with real-time customization — color schemes, themes, animations — no design skills needed
